details.flavorMarkdown: *A towering sentinel carries a spear whose metal hums before the weather changes.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Storm-crowned spear

**Target:** One visible creature within 2 squares. **Player defense:** Fortitude. **Damage type:** lightning.

**Weak defense:** Dazed 2. **Standard defense:** Dazed 1.

### Thrown stone

**Target:** One visible creature within 7 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Limit:** Requires an available loose stone; picking it up is part of this attack. No stone means this attack is unavailable.

### Thunderclap

*A sharp report rolls through the space like a door slammed by the sky.*

One hearing creature within 2 squares gains Deafened 1. Once per turn; no damage.

### Thunderous Answer

*The blow jars loose a thundercrack that rolls back across the space between them.*

After an attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, its visible attacker within 3 squares gains Deafened 2 if it can hear this creature. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. No damage or interruption of the resolved attack.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 3; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Daze the nearest dangerous challenger while using deafening thunder to spoil hearing-dependent coordination. It still has only one Main Action.

**Encounter and conversation:** The sentinel is trying to break a sea curse and treats anyone carrying its mark as a possible witness.

**Habitat:** Highland; quarry; remote stronghold · **Communication:** Common and Giant

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-storm-giant


**Category:** Giant · **Role:** Disabler · **CV:** 58

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Storm-crowned spear | Brawn | 2 Boons | 5 lightning damage. | 8 lightning damage. Dazed 1. | 12 lightning damage. Dazed 2. |
| Thrown stone | Brawn | 2 Boons | 3 physical damage. | 5 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 5/8/12

**Reference type:** lightning

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.55

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.45 → 1.55: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.000, O=10.044. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [stunning strike](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/stunning-strike.md), [thunderclap](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/thunderclap.md), [Thunderous Answer](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/thunderous-answer.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.
